record.paper_title: Selection Principles and Special Sets of Reals
record.original_question: For the Sfin- and Ufin-type covering properties appearing in the Scheepers diagram, is there a model of set theory in which at least one of these properties is preserved under finite products?

evidence.quote: Are any of the Sfin or Ufin type properties in the Scheepers diagram 1 consistently preserved by finite products?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Background and definitions. Let X be a topological space (typically a Lindelöf space, e.g. a set of reals). For a family U of subsets of X, U is called a (open) cover of X if X = ⋃ U and X ∉ U. Let O(X) denote the collection of all open covers of X.

Given collections A and B of covers of X, define the following selection principles:
- S_fin(A, B): For every sequence (U_n : n ∈ ω) with each U_n ∈ A, there exist finite F_n ⊆ U_n such that ⋃_{n∈ω} F_n ∈ B.
- U_fin(A, B): For every sequence (U_n : n ∈ ω) with each U_n ∈ A and no U_n containing a finite subcover of X, there exist finite F_n ⊆ U_n such that { ⋃ F_n : n ∈ ω } ∈ B.

Let Ω denote the collection of ω-covers of X (open covers U such that every finite subset of X is contained in some member of U), and let Γ denote the collection of γ-covers of X (infinite open covers U such that every x ∈ X belongs to all but finitely many members of U).

The Scheepers diagram consists of the (provably distinct, in ZFC, classes of) covering properties obtained by choosing A, B ∈ {O, Ω, Γ}, including in particular the Menger property S_fin(O, O), the property S_fin(Γ, Ω), the Hurewicz property U_fin(O, Γ), the Scheepers property U_fin(O, Ω), and U_fin(O, O) (= S_fin(O, O) for Lindelöf spaces).

A property P of topological spaces is said to be preserved under finite products if whenever X and Y satisfy P, the product X × Y satisfies P.

Question. Is there a model of ZFC in which at least one of the S_fin-type or U_fin-type covering properties appearing in the Scheepers diagram is preserved under finite products (for, say, sets of real numbers)?
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (2024–2025) on the Scheepers diagram continues to investigate productive behavior of these properties, mostly establishing partial productivity results for individual spaces (e.g., b-scale sets being productively Hurewicz/Menger) and exhibiting counterexamples to product preservation in ZFC. No model has been published in which an S_fin- or U_fin-type Scheepers-diagram property is preserved under finite products in general, and recent papers still list related productivity questions as open.

status_evidence.title: Scales, products and the second row of the Scheepers diagram
status_evidence.snippet: Studies productive behavior in the Scheepers diagram; gives counterexamples and partial preservation results, includes an open problems section.
status_evidence.claim: As of 2025, productive behavior of Scheepers-diagram properties under finite products remains the subject of active research with open problems.

status_evidence.title: Several comments about the Scheepers diagram
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses the Scheepers diagram including products and consistency questions about preservation under products.
status_evidence.claim: The question of consistent preservation of these properties under finite products is discussed as open.
